title: Wander
description: UI element component that wanders or drifts randomly across the screen.
content:
Wander

UI element component that applies random wandering movement for dynamic visual effects.

Component UI

Schema

JSON
"wander": {
  "speed": 0.0,
  "range": 0.0,
  "changeInterval": 0.0
}

Description

The Wander component makes a UI element drift randomly around its anchor position, creating an organic floating effect. It is used for decorative UI elements, floating icons, ambient particles in menus, and any visual element that benefits from gentle, unpredictable movement. The element stays within a configurable range of its original position.

Fields

NameTypeDescription
speedfloatMovement speed of the wandering motion in pixels per second.
rangefloatMaximum distance in pixels the element can wander from its origin.
changeIntervalfloatTime in seconds between direction changes.

Example

JSON
{
  "components": {
    "wander": {
      "speed": 15.0,
      "range": 30.0,
      "changeInterval": 2.0
    }
  }
}
